description: Frame-rate fix for NOCustomMaps 1.4.2 maps with many lakes and rivers: NOCustomMaps answers every lake lookup by testing every water sheet of the map, thousands of times a frame. This plugin answers the same lookups from a grid index and returns exactly the same results (it checks its first 10,000 answers per map against NOCustomMaps and switches itself off on any difference). On the Cascadia Falling map that lookup drops from about 5-8 ms to well under 1 ms per frame. Works on clients and hosts; it stands aside if NOCustomMaps' lake code differs from the reviewed 1.4.2 code, or if another mod patches that code in a way that can change the answer.
